methods.generationMethod: Native 32-bit floating-point mathematical color-field synthesis in Python 3.14 (NumPy 2.5.1 + Pillow 12.3.0) with peripheral quiet-zone attenuation and Triangular PDF (TPDF) dithering prior to 8-bit sRGB PNG quantization.
methods.toolAndModel: Python 3.14 / NumPy 2.5.1 / Pillow 12.3.0 (local native synthesis, no external AI model)

nativeGenerationDimensions.horizontal: 3840x2160 (native 4K, no post-generation upscaling of raster AI output; multi-stop analytical fields evaluated on smooth grid and bicubic-interpolated in float32 before full-4K TPDF dithering)
nativeGenerationDimensions.vertical: 2160x3840 (deliberately composed 9:16 coordinate equations, not cropped from 16:9)

methods.parametersAndPrompts: Analytical radial/curvilinear Gaussian and sinusoidal color-field equations using exact family hex tokens from design-tokens.json, attenuated across the central 70%x65% content zone.

methods.category: backgrounds (tactile textures: paper, linen, matte charcoal, frosted surface)
methods.generationMethod: Multi-octave filtered isotropic and directional Gaussian fiber/grain synthesis layered over floating-point base color fields with TPDF dithering.
methods.toolAndModel: Python 3.14 / NumPy 2.5.1 / Pillow 12.3.0 GaussianBlur & float synthesis
methods.parametersAndPrompts: Subtle cotton rag paper fibers, woven warp/weft linen micro-strands, bead-blasted anodized charcoal slate, and frosted midnight acrylic subsurface refraction bands.

methods.toolAndModel: CairoSVG + Pillow 12.3.0 multi-stage depth-of-field blur pipeline
